title: OpenAI o3 announcement
before: o1 had established RL-trained reasoning three months earlier.
problem: Was the approach a one-off, or does reasoning keep improving with more RL and more inference compute?
breakthrough: Large jumps on ARC-AGI and FrontierMath, at very high inference cost per task.
why: It showed the reasoning axis had real headroom. Note the scores are OpenAI-reported, ARC-AGI results are on the public eval set, and Epoch AI later disclosed OpenAI funding and data access for FrontierMath.
next: Released in April 2025 alongside o4-mini, then folded into GPT-5.
inherits: Reasoning capability that scales with inference spend, and the cost question that comes with it.
